meta.name: alfworld-object-locator
meta.description: Use when the agent needs to find a specific object in ALFWorld that is not currently in inventory and whose location is unknown. This skill parses the environment observation, ranks receptacles by likelihood of containing the target object using common-sense reasoning, and outputs a navigation action to the most promising location.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在ALFWorld中自动定位并导航到目标物体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在ALFWorld环境中需要快速找到不在背包中的物品
copy.tagline_en: Automatically locate and navigate to target objects in ALFWorld
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find items not in inventory in ALFWorld

howto.what: 当在ALFWorld游戏中需要寻找某个不在背包且位置未知的物体时，Claude会分析当前环境中的容器，用常识推理按可能性排序，然后依次前往每个容器查找目标物体。
howto.when: 当任务要求一个特定物体，该物体不在背包中，且当前环境观察没有明确说明其位置时触发。

say.note: 技能会从台面、抽屉等容器开始搜索。

say.text: 我的手机不见了，找找它在哪。
say.note: 优先搜索桌子、床头柜等常用位置。

say.text: 我需要一个苹果，它在哪个容器里？
say.note: 从冰箱、台面、微波炉等区域查找。

howto.what_en: When an object is needed in ALFWorld but not in inventory and location unknown, Claude parses the environment, ranks receptacles by common-sense likelihood, and navigates to the best candidate to find it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task requires a specific object not in inventory and its location is not stated in the current observation.

say_en.text: Find the knife in the kitchen.
I lost my phone, please find it.
I need an apple, where is it?
